HexKagune 1.2.4 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 52). Testing build.

- **War first person, arms:** the giant posed arms and shoulder plates no longer fill the screen; War now shows vanilla's own hand with his armour on it, like at rest.
- **War first person, blows:** that hand swings as each punch or blade blow lands (not on kicks), and on the grasp and Black Sun's punch; only you see it.
- **War first person, rinkaku:** nothing of the rinkaku is drawn within about a block of your eyes, so you only see the tentacles reaching out ahead, not sweeping through your face.
- **War first person, aim:** the rinkaku now lines up with where you look, not where your body faces, so blows no longer strike off to the side when you turn.
- **War first person, no shake:** War's twitching head no longer jerks everything in view.
